title: The Works: a shorter top on a phone
lines: On an upright phone the top of the screen is two rows: your Leaf and Coins, then the power. The way out and the settings button head the column of buttons on the right.
Folded, the card in the top corner is one square button beside the power. A number on its corner counts the orders ready to hand over, and ! means a commission can be taken.

more.head: Fixed
points: On a phone held sideways, buttons in the right-hand column that do not fit go into a second column. Before, the last one could be below the bottom of the screen.
A card opened during a walk through trouble no longer covers the walk's bar.
